players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (NMR): SuperCOOL MARVEL HCN, a liquid-nitrogen-cooled cryogenic NMR probe with triple-resonance capability (1H/19F, 13C and 15N) for protein, peptide and nucleic-acid measurements; the initial release is for 600 MHz NMR systems and sales are scheduled to begin in August 2026. Dedicated cold preamplifiers give a 2- to 3-fold sensitivity improvement for 1H/19F and 13C versus JEOL's standard room-temperature HCN probe; the open liquid-nitrogen cooling system uses significantly less energy than helium-gas-circulating cryogenic systems.
quarterly_data.figure: 600 MHz systems; sales from August 2026; 2- to 3-fold sensitivity vs room-temperature probe
